_meta.batch: Examine - lokacja StonetopInn/Gospoda Stonetop (54 terminy, ~17 mikroscen) - PIERWSZA lokacja gry, przed dotarciem do lodzi podwodnej. Grimoire czuwa samotnie, podczas gdy Sally spi - wiekszosc linii to jego solowy monolog, az do sceny budzenia jej (fullscreen1) gdy dostrzegaja zielone swiatlo.
_meta.speaker_resolution: speaker_map.json NIE POKRYWA kategorii Examine. Mowcy przypisani na podstawie kontekstu/tresci. Poniewaz Sally spi przez wiekszosc tej lokacji, prawie wszystkie linie to monolog Grimoire'a - Sally pojawia sie dopiero w fullscreen1 (budzenie sie).

Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_InnLight/S.en: I thought I heard something outside...
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_InnLight/S.pl: Wydawało mi się, że coś słyszałem na zewnątrz...
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_InnLight/S.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_Sally/Sect.en: To be fair, it is four in the morning.
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_Sally/Sect.pl: Żeby było uczciwie, jest czwarta rano.
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_Sally/Sect.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_Sally/Sect.en: I agreed to stay awake and see if anyone shows up.
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_Sally/Sect.pl: Zgodziłem się nie spać i sprawdzić, czy ktoś się pojawi.
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_Sally/Sect.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_barrels/Se.en: There's nothing written on the barrels.
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_barrels/Se.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_barrels/Se.en: I'm sure they were once filled with some kind of wonderful unsanctioned local ale.
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_barrels/Se.pl: Jestem pewien, że kiedyś były wypełnione jakimś wspaniałym, niezalegalizowanym lokalnym piwem.
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_barrels/Se.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_bg/Section.en: It's what remains of the Stonetop Inn.
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_bg/Section.pl: To, co zostało z Gospody Stonetop.
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_bg/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_bg/Section.en: Although I... don't have any point of reference - maybe it looked like this when it was still open.
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_bg/Section.pl: Chociaż... nie mam żadnego punktu odniesienia - może wyglądała tak nawet, gdy jeszcze była otwarta.
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_bg/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_bg/Section.en: Looks like it's been closed for some time...
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_bg/Section.pl: Wygląda na to, że jest zamknięta od jakiegoś czasu...
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_bg/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_board/Sect.en:
[i]Fishing Trips.
On Board The Dearest Selena.[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_board/Sect.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_board/Sect.en: [i]Enquire with Felicia Stonetop at the bar, or with Sylvia Seafoam at the harbor.[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_board/Sect.pl: [i]Pytać Felicię Stonetop przy barze albo Sylvię Seafoam w porcie.[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_board/Sect.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_board/Sect.en: I'm guessing that's the name of the ship.
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_board/Sect.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_book 1/Sec.en: It's some book Sally's been reading.
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_book 1/Sec.pl: To jakaś książka, którą czytała Sally.
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_book 1/Sec.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_book 1/Sec.en: She insisted that we bring it with us - although I'm not sure why.
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_book 1/Sec.pl: Nalegała, żebyśmy ją ze sobą zabrali - choć nie jestem pewien czemu.
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_book 1/Sec.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_book 2/Sec.en: [i]Hex of the Helmsman, by J. D. Wirman.[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_book 2/Sec.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_book 2/Sec.en: Looks like Sally's read through it a couple of times already...
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_book 2/Sec.pl: Wygląda na to, że Sally przeczytała ją już kilka razy...
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_book 2/Sec.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_book 2/Sec.en: I wonder what's so interesting about it?
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_book 2/Sec.pl: Zastanawiam się, co w niej takiego interesującego?
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_book 2/Sec.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_casefile 1.en: It's the case file - the reason we're here.
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_casefile 1.pl: To akta sprawy - powód, dla którego tu jesteśmy.
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_casefile 1.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_casefile 1.en: It was left for us right here on the bar.
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_casefile 1.pl: Zostały dla nas zostawione właśnie tutaj, na barze.
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_casefile 1.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_casefile 2.en: As far as I know, that's who hired us - and who left the case file here in the Inn.
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_casefile 2.pl: O ile wiem, to ona nas zatrudniła - i to ona zostawiła akta sprawy tutaj, w Gospodzie.
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_casefile 2.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_casefile 2.en:
But where are they now?
Where's anyone?
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_casefile 2.pl:
Ale gdzie ona teraz jest?
Gdzie ktokolwiek jest?
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_casefile 2.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_crab/Secti.en: ...just in case anyone missed the overt nautical theming.
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_crab/Secti.pl: ...na wypadek, gdyby ktoś przeoczył ten oczywisty morski motyw.
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_crab/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_fish/Secti.en: A wooden carving of a fish skeleton.
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_fish/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_fish/Secti.en: If the windows weren't boarded up, you'd be able to see it from outside.
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_fish/Secti.pl: Gdyby okna nie były zabite deskami, można by ją zobaczyć z zewnątrz.
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_fish/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_floor/Sect.en: Nobody's cleaned the floor in a while.
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_floor/Sect.pl: Nikt nie sprzątał tej podłogi od dawna.
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_floor/Sect.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_fullscreen.en: Sally, wake up! We have to go!
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_fullscreen.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_fullscreen.en: Because, there's an eerie green light trying to lure us outside.
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_fullscreen.pl: Bo jest tam niesamowite zielone światło, które próbuje nas zwabić na zewnątrz.
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_fullscreen.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_fullscreen.en: Oh. That's a pretty good reason.
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_fullscreen.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_fullscreen.en: To move around, use the map button in the bottom left.
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_fullscreen.pl: Aby się poruszać, użyj przycisku mapy w lewym dolnym rogu.
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_fullscreen.speaker: Grimoire (domniemany)

Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_fullscreen.en: I think it's time to go outside.
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_fullscreen.pl: Myślę, że czas wyjść na zewnątrz.
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_fullscreen.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_lamp/Secti.en: That's also what [h]I[/h] plan to do when [h]I[/h] retire.
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_lamp/Secti.pl: To też jest to, co [h]ja[/h] planuję robić, kiedy [h]ja[/h] przejdę na emeryturę.
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_lamp/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_lamp/Secti.en: They've stopped giving out light and taken up dust collecting.
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_lamp/Secti.pl: Przestały dawać światło i zajęły się zbieraniem kurzu.
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_lamp/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_serpent/Se.en: It's a painting of a sea serpent.
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_serpent/Se.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_serpent/Se.en: Wait... is it a serpent if it has legs?
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_serpent/Se.pl: Czekaj... czy to jest wąż, skoro ma nogi?
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_serpent/Se.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_serpent/Se.en: Ah. Thanks for clearing that up.
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_serpent/Se.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_stools/Sec.en: The wood is rotting, so I've strategically chosen [h]not[/h] to sit on them.
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_stools/Sec.pl: Drewno gnije, więc strategicznie postanowiłem [h]nie[/h] siadać na nich.
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_stools/Sec.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_windows/Se.en: Someone's done a pretty half-hearted job of boarding up the windows.
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_windows/Se.pl: Ktoś dość niedbale zabił deskami okna.
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_windows/Se.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_windows/Se.en: Maybe they left in a hurry.
Examine/Exam_Area_StonetopInn_windows/Se.speaker: Grimoire
